title: war of eden Mission 1- the first harvest
author: Equal-Instance6456
selftext:
so this is a rough start of the game ill be posting regularly  once a week after this with update... this will be the only demo i show of the missions though 

current build plan - Im going to first focus on the feel and play style of the game. the goal is create a cosmic horror RTS.  you play as the cosmic horror that has crash landed on this planet after taking over 2 other planets so there will be a indepth lore behind the game and characters you come across   
right now i want focus on the missions, gameplay and behavior cut scences will be haft ass done but not final product cause i will have to learn blender animation to make the actual cutscences i want so the final product will be alot more cinimatic.  
enjoy the first mission and id love to hear your thoughts
